authority: User requested an acceptance plan only; no execution authorization inferred
exposure: WTB and Hill of Towie2025 have been viewed; this is result-informed development planning
estimand: Finite-program mean surrogate loss conditional on fixed five instances and declared observed population, not Bayes pure information value

task.history_policy: Fixed event window t-35..t; stale tail masked, no backward expansion

thresholds.status: Normative research investment criteria proposed after viewing old outcomes; neither TSTE cutoff nor operator SLA

Cstar.design: Historical fixed-source/fixed-layer fresh-I reference five-instance mean cost; freeze before new confirmation; shared for signed severity directions

inference.MLP: Secondary estimator check, never substitutes for failed confirmation primary
inference.weather_resampling: Shared time blocks; no independent turbine or seed replication

learners.row_budget_rule: min(360000, shared valid fit rows); no duplicated rows to meet budget; one row per time for group policies
learners.other_settings: Reuse bound existing implementations; implementation version and complete settings must be frozen before execution
learners.configuration_selection: Historical no-Z reference only; paired cells receive equal opportunities; no evaluation-gain selection
learners.offset_selection: One q shared by five instances; every instance historically risk qualified; minimum mean cost, exact tie choose larger q; no qualified q => no choice

population.training_and_offset: Shared finite future-P population; paired training indices
population.selection_and_primary_score: Finite future P and finite current P and all three current blade angles; common across ages
population.secondary_score: All finite future-P population with explicitly observed Z including missingness pattern; separate interpretation
population.group_primary: Fixed members; every member future P/current P/current pitch available; no partial-sum target or zero imputation

success_routes: A measured state adds important conditional finite-program value
B power update substitutes within declared tolerances after both updates show value
C precise bounded low value, subject to separate scientific-impact assessment
remaining_materials: Joint population and group support counts
